PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.

5. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.

8. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.

9. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

10. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.

12. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

14. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

16. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.

----
